# AJM Reals

> Real estate video, drone, and photography. Cinematic listing films for
> agents, developers, and builders across New York, New Jersey, and Connecticut.
> Established 2022.

## What we do

- **Listing films** — cinematic walkthrough video of a property, edited and
  delivered ready for MLS, social, and email.
- **Drone aerials** — aerial coverage giving a listing scale and context.
- **Photography** — edited stills for MLS and marketing.
- **2D floor plans** — available as an add-on to any shoot.

We also shoot for non-real-estate businesses: law firms, gyms and studios,
restaurants, and medspas and clinics.

## Pricing

**One-off — single listing**
- $400 for one walkthrough film, homes up to 1,000 sq ft
- +$75 per additional 500 sq ft
- Add photos +$275 · Add a 2D floor plan +$50 · Both +$300
- No retainer, no minimum term

**Monthly retainers**
- **Starter — $1,500/mo**, 3-month minimum: 2 videos, 1 shoot day, 5 edited
  photos, 1 revision round, 10-day delivery
- **Growth — $3,000/mo**, 6-month minimum: 5 videos, 2 shoot days, 15 edited
  photos, drone, social cuts, content calendar, 2 revision rounds, 7-day
  delivery
- **Partner — $5,500/mo**, 12-month term: 10 videos, 4 shoot days, 30+ edited
  photos, drone, social cuts, quarterly strategy session, usage rights,
  unlimited revisions, 5-day delivery

## Service area

New York, New Jersey, Connecticut. Recent work includes
Brooklyn NY, White Plains NY, and Lloyd Harbor NY.

## Free resource

**The Pre-Shoot Checklist** — a two-page guide for agents covering what to
prepare 48 hours, 24 hours, and the morning before a property shoot, plus how
to time natural light for interiors, exteriors, golden hour, and twilight.
Available at /checklist.
